ev.k3_bully.title: The Bully
ev.k3_bully.text: For three days a hulking boy from the next street has been lying in wait for you: he takes whatever you are holding and shoves you into the dust. Today he is in your way again, feet planted wide, grinning.
ev.k3_bully.fight: Go for him first, come what may
ev.k3_bully.fight.success: You clung to him like a burr, and he was so surprised he sat down in the dust. He never touched you again - in fact, he started crossing the street.
ev.k3_bully.fight.failure: He was twice your weight, and you came home with a bloody nose. But the street started saying: at least you didn't run.
ev.k3_bully.give: Hand over what he wants and keep out of his way
ev.k3_bully.gang: Call the whole gang for backup
ev.k3_bully.gang.success: Five of you came out together, and the bully suddenly remembered he had urgent business at home.
ev.k3_bully.gang.failure: The gang promised to come and didn't. You stood there alone, and everyone felt awkward.
ev.k3_bully_grown.title: An Old Acquaintance
ev.k3_bully_grown.text: A stooped man in rags is standing at the gate, asking for something to eat. It takes you a moment: it's that bully you once grappled with in the dust. He recognizes you too - and looks at the ground.
ev.k3_bully_grown.feed: Feed him and say nothing about the past
ev.k3_bully_grown.remind: Ask if he remembers that road
ev.k3_nickname.title: Froggy
ev.k3_nickname.text: You fell flat into the puddle by the well in front of the whole street and climbed out covered in green slime from head to toe. By evening you had a new name - Froggy.
ev.k3_nickname.own_it: Say "Ribbit!" and laugh along with everyone
ev.k3_nickname.fight: Fight anyone who calls you that
ev.k3_nickname.fight.success: A week later the nickname was only ever whispered, and only around corners.
ev.k3_nickname.fight.failure: You fought three of them and lost to all three. Now you're Beaten Froggy.
ev.k3_nickname.feat.success: You climbed the tallest tree around and waved to the whole street from the top. From now on you're Squirrel - a different thing altogether.
ev.k3_nickname.feat.failure: You tried to climb a high wall, slipped - and landed right back in the same puddle. Froggy it is.
ev.k3_nickname_sticks.title: Hey, Froggy!
ev.k3_nickname_sticks.text: Someone in the market shouted, "Hey, Froggy!" - and you turned around before you could think. So many years, and the childhood nickname lives on: the neighbors' little ones have picked it up from the grown-ups.
ev.k3_oath.title: Friends Forever
ev.k3_oath.text: Your friend {npc} led you behind the old wall where no one could hear and whispered: let's swear to be true to each other for the rest of our lives. For real, the way grown-ups swear.
ev.k3_oath.blood: Nick your fingers and mix the blood
ev.k3_oath.blood.success: A sharp pebble, two drops of blood, solemn words you made up yourselves. You walked home in silence, very serious.
ev.k3_oath.blood.failure: The finger festered for a week, and you had to invent a story about how you cut it. But an oath is an oath.
ev.k3_oath_called.title: A Childhood Oath
ev.k3_oath_called.text: Late in the evening {npc} came to your door, gaunt and empty-handed. "Remember what we promised each other behind that wall? I have no one else to turn to."
ev.k3_told_secret.title: Someone Else's Secret
ev.k3_told_secret.text: {npc} told you in secret that {g=npc_sex:he|she} is still afraid of the dark and can only fall asleep with a little light burning nearby. And today the leader of the older kids said: tell us something funny about somebody, and you're in.
ev.k3_told_secret.invent: Tell something funny about the leader himself
ev.k3_told_secret.invent.success: The gang laughed until they cried. So did the leader - he had no choice. You were in.
ev.k3_told_secret.invent.failure: The leader didn't appreciate the joke, and you ran home very fast, just not fast enough.
ev.k3_secret_trust.title: Someone Who Can Keep Quiet
ev.k3_secret_trust.text: {npc} took you aside: "I've known since we were children that you don't blab. Keep my savings for me while I sort out my affairs. There's no one else I'd trust."
ev.k3_secret_trust.decline: Refuse: other people's money, other people's trouble
ev.k3_new_kid.title: The New Kid
ev.k3_new_kid.text: A new family has moved onto your street. Their child talks with a funny accent, dresses differently, and never says a word. The neighborhood kids have already made up a nasty rhyme about the newcomer.
ev.k3_new_kid.befriend: Ask the new kid to play
ev.k3_new_kid.watch: Watch from the side and see what happens
ev.k3_new_kid_return.title: The New Kid Comes Back
ev.k3_new_kid_return.text: Someone called out to you on the road. The new kid you were the first to invite to play has grown up, seen distant lands, and come back with goods to sell. "You were the only one who talked to me back then. I never forgot."
ev.k3_new_kid_return.gift: Accept a gift from far away
ev.k3_new_kid_return.stories: Bring him home and listen to his stories till dawn
ev.k3_fruit_raid.title: The Neighbor's Orchard
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text: Behind the neighbor's fence the fruit is ripe - so sweet the whole street smells of it. The gang has decided: today, when the owner dozes off in the heat. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.RUS: Behind the neighbor's wattle fence the apples are ripe - so juicy the whole street smells of them. The gang has decided: today, when the owner naps after lunch. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.EUR: Behind the neighbor's stone wall the pears are ripe - so sweet the wasps are getting drunk on them. The gang has decided: today, when the owner naps after lunch. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.E03: Behind the neighbor's wall the figs are ripe - so ripe they're splitting on the branch. The gang has decided: today, in the midday heat, when the owner dozes off. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.ISL: Behind the neighbor's mud-brick wall the apricots are ripe - so sweet the whole quarter smells of them. The gang has decided: today, when the owner dozes off in the midday heat. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.IND: The mangoes on the neighbor's tree have turned yellow, and their sweet smell hangs over the whole street. The gang has decided: today, when the owner dozes off in the heat. Someone has to go up first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.CHN: Behind the neighbor's wall the peaches are ripe - rosy, fuzzy, big as a fist. The gang has decided: today, when the owner naps after lunch. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.text.JPN: Behind the neighbor's bamboo fence the persimmons are ripe, orange as little lanterns. The gang has decided: today, when the owner dozes off. Someone has to go over first.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.climb.success: You stuffed your shirt full and swung back over without touching a branch. That evening the gang feasted on the loot and gazed at you in awe.
ev.k3_fruit_raid.climb.failure: The owner woke to the crack of branches. You got stuck on the fence, he got a good look at you - and that evening he came to complain at your house.
ev.k3_found_thing.title: Finders Keepers
ev.k3_found_thing.text: Something glinted in the dust by the road - a bracelet of bright beads. You and a boy from the next street spotted it at the same instant and stepped on it at the same instant. "Mine!" "No, mine!"
ev.k3_found_thing.grab.success: You yanked the bracelet free and ran like the wind. Now it's yours - and it lives under your pillow.
ev.k3_found_thing.grab.failure: He was stronger: he got the bracelet, and you got a bump on the forehead.
ev.k3_found_thing.game: Play for it fairly, with pebbles
ev.k3_found_thing.game.success: You won fair and square, and even he admitted it. The bracelet is yours, and now the boy keeps asking you to play.
ev.k3_found_thing.game.failure: You lost, but fairly, and he remembered that. He has the bracelet; you have his respect.
ev.k3_found_thing.owner: Look for whoever lost it together
ev.k3_fight_makeup.title: The Quarrel
ev.k3_fight_makeup.text: Your friend {npc} hasn't spoken to you for three days. You argued over a game - who cheated whom - and you shoved {g=npc_sex:him|her} into the dust. Now {g=npc_sex:he|she} plays with the others and acts as if you don't exist.
ev.k3_fight_makeup.first: Be the first to make up
ev.k3_fight_makeup.first.success: You mumbled, "Fine. I was wrong." {npc} sniffed, and a minute later the two of you were chasing chickens together.
ev.k3_fight_makeup.first.failure: {npc} turned away and went off to the others. You had to wait another week.
ev.k3_fight_makeup.gift: Leave your best treasure on {g=npc_sex:his|her} doorstep
ev.k3_fight_makeup.wait: Wait for {g=npc_sex:him|her} to come to you
ev.k3_dare_wall.title: Dare You
ev.k3_dare_wall.text: The older kids sit on the old wall above the gully and take turns jumping down onto a heap of sand. It's high - taller than two grown men. Little ones aren't allowed, but today they've called you up: "Well? Scared?"
ev.k3_dare_wall.jump.success: Wind in your ears, a thump - and you're standing knee-deep in sand. The older kids slap you on the back: you're one of them now.
ev.k3_dare_wall.jump.failure: You landed on your side and twisted your ankle. You limped for two weeks, and nobody at home ever found out how it happened.
ev.k3_dare_wall.lower: Jump from a lower spot and act like that was the plan
ev.k3_dare_wall.lower.success: You jumped with such a swagger that nobody noticed the switch.
ev.k3_dare_wall.lower.failure: They noticed. Now they call you Doorstep.
ev.k3_hideout.title: The Fortress
ev.k3_hideout.text: For a whole week you and the gang built a hut in the thickets past the last houses: branches, a mat for a door, a hearth of three stones. And today the kids from the next street turned up and announced the hut was theirs now.
ev.k3_hideout.defend.success: The siege lasted till evening, but the invaders retreated, losing one sandal and all their pride. The fortress stood.
ev.k3_hideout.defend.failure: They kept the hut, and you kept a black eye.
ev.k3_hideout.share.success: By evening the two gangs were one, and the hut was twice as big.
ev.k3_hideout.share.failure: The newcomers decided you were cowards and threw everyone out.
ev.k3_hideout.new: Leave and build a new one - better and more secret
ev.k3_street_war.title: Street Against Street
ev.k3_street_war.text: The boys on your street are going to war with the next street: sticks for spears, basket lids for shields, clods of clay for stones. They want you in the front row.
ev.k3_street_war.front.success: You marched in front and yelled louder than anyone. The enemy ran all the way to the well. That evening they talked about you like a general.
ev.k3_street_war.front.failure: A clod of clay hit you right in the forehead. The lump was the size of an egg, but you didn't leave the battlefield.
ev.k3_street_war.truce: Go to the enemy with an offer of peace
ev.k3_street_war.truce.success: Instead of a battle, both streets played ball until dark. The grown-ups never knew what war you had prevented.
ev.k3_street_war.truce.failure: Both sides called you a coward - the one thing they agreed on.
ev.k3_street_war.home: Pretend to be sick and stay home
ev.k3_other_kid.title: The Outsider
ev.k3_other_kid.text: At the edge of the neighborhood you made friends with a child from a newcomer family: they speak differently, eat differently, and keep different customs. The grown-ups on your street give them sidelong looks and tell you to stay away.
ev.k3_other_kid.text.hindu: You made friends with a child from a low-caste family. With people like them, your folk don't eat from the same dishes or even stand too close. The grown-ups frown and tell you to stay away.
ev.k3_other_kid.open: Bring your new friend into your yard for all to see
ev.k3_other_kid.open.success: At first everyone stared. Then a neighbor gave you both a treat, and a month later nobody looked twice at the outsider.
ev.k3_other_kid.open.failure: There was shouting, and you both got in trouble. But you stayed friends - you just got more careful.
ev.k3_other_kid_help.title: An Old Friendship
ev.k3_other_kid_help.text: Your childhood friend from that newcomer family, the one you were forbidden to play with, is now a respected figure among their own people. Word comes that he remembers your games and invites you into business with his kin.
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.title: The Broken Jar
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.text: Your friend {npc} was kicking a ball around and smashed the neighbor woman's big water jar. Now she's going from yard to yard asking everyone: "Who did it? Did you see?" {npc} is looking at you with pleading eyes.
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.lie: Say you were together at the other end of the street all day
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.lie.success: She believed you and moved on. {npc} followed you around all evening like a shadow.
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.lie.failure: You blushed so hard it was obvious. You both got scolded, but {npc} appreciated that you tried.
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.together: Talk {g=npc_sex:him|her} into owning up together with you
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.together.success: The neighbor grumbled and made the two of you carry water for her for a week. It turned out to be fun.
ev.k3_lie_for_friend.together.failure: {npc} called you a traitor and ran off.
ev.k3_lie_again.title: One More Time
ev.k3_lie_again.text: {npc} came to you pale as a sheet: "They're accusing me of something I didn't do. Tell the judge I was with you that evening. You covered for me once - remember the neighbor's jar?" Where {g=npc_sex:he|she} really was that evening, you have no idea.
ev.k3_lie_again.lie.success: They believed you. {npc} hugged you and wouldn't let go - and you lay awake for a long time afterward.
ev.k3_lie_again.lie.failure: The judge caught you contradicting yourself. The shame fell on you both.
ev.k3_first_crush.title: The Pebble with a Hole
ev.k3_first_crush.text: You keep finding yourself near the house where {g:the girl with the loudest laugh|the boy who climbs trees better than anyone} lives. Your heart pounds like after a race. And today you found a pebble with a hole right through the middle by the road - they say those bring luck.
ev.k3_first_crush.give: Give the pebble as a present
ev.k3_first_crush.give.success: {g:She|He} blushed and tucked the pebble away. You walked home without feeling the ground under your feet.
ev.k3_first_crush.give.failure: {g:She|He} snorted in front of everyone, and the other kids teased you about your sweetheart for a month.
ev.k3_first_crush.messenger: Ask one of the kids to pass it on
ev.k3_first_crush.messenger.success: The pebble was delivered, and a flower came back in return. Without a single word.
ev.k3_first_crush.messenger.failure: The messenger told the whole street who was sending what to whom.
ev.k3_first_crush.keep: Keep the pebble and tell no one
ev.k3_crush_later.title: That Same Pebble
ev.k3_crush_later.text: In the festival crowd you bumped into the one you once gave a pebble with a hole. You've both long since grown up. And there, on a cord around {g:her|his} neck, hangs that very pebble.
ev.k3_race_prize.title: The Big Race
ev.k3_race_prize.text: The gang is holding a race: from the well to the old tree and back. The winner gets a sweet someone swiped from a feast table - and the right to be in charge of the games for a week.
ev.k3_race_prize.fair: Run fair, as hard as you can
ev.k3_race_prize.fair.success: You came in first by a mile and ate the sweet slowly, so everyone could watch.
ev.k3_race_prize.fair.failure: You came in third, and your legs ached till nightfall. Next time they'll be faster.
ev.k3_race_prize.shortcut.success: You burst out by the tree in first place, and nobody could figure out how.
ev.k3_race_prize.shortcut.failure: There was a dog in the yard. You came in last, minus a piece of your shirt, and everyone knew why.
ev.k3_race_prize.yield: Slow down and let a little one who's running his heart out go ahead
ev.k3_game_too_far.title: The Prisoner
ev.k3_game_too_far.text: You were playing war, and the gang took a little boy from the next street prisoner: tied him to a tree, then ran off to storm the enemy fortress. It's getting dark now. Of all of you, only you remembered the prisoner is still there.
ev.k3_game_too_far.confess: Untie him, walk him home and own up to his family
ev.k3_game_too_far.confess.success: His family shouted at first, and then gave you a treat - for your honesty.
ev.k3_game_too_far.confess.failure: You took the blame for the whole gang by yourself.
ev.k3_game_too_far.leave: Don't go back: he'll get loose somehow
ev.k3_girls_circle.title: The Older Girls
ev.k3_girls_circle.text: The older girls gather on the porch: they braid each other's hair, string beads, and whisper about their own things. You've long dreamed of sitting with them. Today the eldest said: bring your best bead - then we'll see.
ev.k3_girls_circle.refuse: Keep it: friendship isn't for sale
ev.k3_girls_circle.own: Start your own circle with the younger girls
ev.k3_girls_circle.own.success: A month later the older girls were eyeing your circle and asking what you were all laughing about.
ev.k3_girls_circle.own.failure: The little ones scattered after a day: one cried, another got called home.
ev.k3_target.title: The Last Throw
ev.k3_target.text: A potsherd sits on a stake by the road, and the whole gang takes turns throwing stones at it. Whoever knocks it off wins the pot: a handful of shells, a feather and a shiny bead. One throw left - yours - and everyone is watching.
ev.k3_target.aim.success: Clink! The potsherd flew off the stake, and the gang howled so loudly the neighbors peeked out of their gates.
ev.k3_target.aim.failure: Missed by a hair. You aimed so long your arm got tired.
ev.k3_target.hard.success: The potsherd shattered, and the stake tilted for good measure. The street had never seen a throw like it.
ev.k3_target.hard.failure: The stone sailed over someone's fence, and out came the owner with a stick.
ev.k3_target.pass: Give your throw to a little one who hasn't hit it once
ev.k3_gang_leader.title: Who's in Charge
ev.k3_gang_leader.text: The leader of your gang has grown up: now he works with the grown-ups from dawn to dusk and doesn't come out to the street anymore. The kids are arguing over who's in charge now, and they keep glancing at you.
ev.k3_gang_leader.claim.success: Nobody objected. From that day on, the games start when you show up.
ev.k3_gang_leader.claim.failure: They laughed at you and picked someone else. You were stung for a week.
ev.k3_gang_leader.back: Suggest the strongest kid as leader
ev.k3_gang_leader.council: Say there's no need for a leader: we'll decide together
ev.k3_gang_leader.council.success: Deciding together took longer, but it was more fun. The gang grew closer.
ev.k3_gang_leader.council.failure: A day later the gang had a row and split in two.
ev.k3_rich_kid.title: The Child Behind the Gate
ev.k3_rich_kid.text: For a long time a boy in clean, fine clothes has been watching your games from behind the gate of a rich house: clearly he isn't allowed out. Today he beckoned you over and showed you a marvelous toy through the gap.
ev.k3_rich_kid.invite: Invite him to play with you
ev.k3_rich_kid.invite.success: He slipped out the gate and ran around with you until evening, filthy from head to toe. He got in trouble later, but the next day he was at the gate again.
ev.k3_rich_kid.invite.failure: A servant caught you both at the gate. You got the blame for luring the master's child out.
ev.k3_rich_kid.trade: Trade your whistle for the toy
ev.k3_rich_kid.trade.success: He gave up the toy for your whistle and was every bit as happy as you: no one had ever let him whistle before.
ev.k3_rich_kid.trade.failure: His nannies saw the swap, took both things away and chased you from the gate.
ev.k3_rich_kid.mock: Stick your tongue out at him
ev.k3_m_hide_seek.text: You hid so well at hide-and-seek that nobody ever found you, and everyone went home to supper. You sat in an empty basket until dark - proud and hungry.
ev.k3_m_mud_city.text: After the rain you and the neighborhood kids built a whole city out of mud by the ditch: walls, gates, a market, even a temple. That night it rained again, and in the morning you started over.
ev.k3_m_echo.text: You and the other kids found the place where the echo lives and spent half the day shouting nonsense at it. The echo shouted back the same words, but somehow they weren't as funny.
ev.k3_m_sticks_war.text: A stick was your sword, a basket lid your shield, and the neighbor's dog the enemy army. The army won.
ev.k3_m_spit_seeds.text: There was a contest to see who could spit a fruit pit the farthest. You won by a mile and strutted around like a general until evening.
ev.k3_m_whistle.text: An older boy taught you to whistle with two fingers. A week later you had mastered it, and the whole street had lost its patience.
ev.k3_m_counting_rhyme.text: You learned the counting-out rhyme every kid on the street uses. Nobody understands half the words, but getting even one wrong is a disgrace.
ev.k3_m_scars.text: The kids compared scars. Yours, on the knee, from falling off a fence, was judged the best: long, crooked, and with a story.
ev.k3_m_scary_tale.text: In the evening on the doorstep, an older neighbor boy told a story about a spirit that roams the rooftops looking for naughty children. You lay awake all night, listening to every rustle.
ev.k3_m_beetles.text: You held a beetle race, each beetle tied to a thread. Yours turned out to be the fastest - it just kept running backward.
ev.k3_m_secret_language.text: Your friend {npc} and you invented a secret language: you add "ki" to every syllable. The grown-ups can't understand a thing, and the two of you laugh until you get hiccups.
ev.k3_m_shared_sweet.text: Your friend {npc} split your only sweet exactly in half, measuring it with a blade of grass. You argued longer than you ate.
ev.k3_m_glance.text: At the well {g:a girl|a boy} from the next street suddenly smiled at you. You turned red to the ears and spent half the day in a daze.
ev.k3_m_tree_top.text: You climbed the tallest tree around and saw all the rooftops at once. Then you realized climbing down is much scarier than climbing up, and waited until evening for someone to take pity on you.
ev.k3_m_first_rain.text: After a long spell of heat the rain came pouring down, and every kid on the street ran out shrieking: dancing in puddles, catching drops in their mouths, and falling in the mud on purpose.
ev.k3_m_clapping.text: The girls taught you a clapping game with a song - faster and faster until someone slips up. By evening you were slipping up less than anyone.
ev.k3_m_wrestling.text: Wrestling in the dust in the middle of the street: you pinned a boy a head taller than you. He said he slipped, but everyone saw.
ev.k3_m_grumpy_old.text: The old man from the corner house is forever chasing you kids off the street for making noise. But today, when no one was looking, he silently pressed a handful of dried fruit into your hand.
ev.k3_m_stars.text: At night you and the other kids lay on the warm ground and counted stars. You got to a hundred, argued about who lost count, and started over.
ev.k3_m_gang_sign.text: Your gang has a secret sign now - three slanting lines. You scratched it on every wall in the neighborhood, and the grown-ups are still wondering what it means.
